- **Required set untouched, verified:** `scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs` `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` names only `ci.yml` (5), `lint.yml` (2) and `governed-surface-guard.yml` (1); none of the guards or patrols is a required context, so merging them changes no queue gate. The merged guard job must keep the `merge_group` trigger for the three that carry it (advisory in the queue today).
- Facets read: same direction; the seat agrees with **A** (lint's schedule skips when the same sha already has a green push run; four patrols → one file, four jobs; four guards → one job, four steps), three Tier H PRs in the skills lane. Not B (leaves the daily repeat) and not C. Workload: skills · 3 PRs Tier H · precedent #25771.

Ruling: batch #397 item 2 · letter A · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-26T13:18Z

Recorded by the director seat (summon #51 continuation, `session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708, brief 6416349576). The maintainer's one-word reply to batch #397 accepts every seat letter; this card's is **A**: (i) `lint.yml`'s scheduled run opens with a step that looks for a completed green `push` run on `github.sha` and skips the battery when one exists (ci.yml's schedule is untouched — it is the full-battery run, P3); (ii) the four daily patrols become one `fleet-patrols.yml` with four jobs on their existing crons, each job keeping its own failure signal and minimal permissions; (iii) the four PR-body guards become one workflow, one job, four steps, keeping the `merge_group` trigger the three guards carry today (`closing-target-claim-guard`, `partof-closing-keyword-guard`, `single-claim-path-guard`) and no checkout for the step that needs none. Verified before recording: `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` (`scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs`) names only `ci.yml`, `lint.yml` and `governed-surface-guard.yml`, so no required context moves. Not B (the schedule and patrol spend stays) and not C.

Workload of the chosen letter (card column): three Tier H PRs (`.github/workflows/**`), one per concern, in the lane that owns PM-protocol workflows; precedent #25771.

Execution: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this act; `pm:awaiting-maintainer` removed in the same stroke (it sat beside the decision label, no `Maintainer-action:`). The card carries `domain:devx` from triage while the body names the skills lane for PM-protocol workflows — the triage seat settles the lane on first claim (`pm:retriage` if it disagrees), ⛔ not this seat. Each dispatch carries `Ruling-ref:` naming this comment and a file-by-file diff against the retired workflow; each PR stays draft until an approver's word (Tier H). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
